ops.title: 10.0.0 branch (unified capt-hook.toml + plugin discovery, attach deleted) implemented and review-hardened; release gated on fleet pre-staging
ops.body:
capt-hook 10.0.0 lives on `worktree-packs-unify` (worktree `.claude/worktrees/packs-unify`), ready 2026-07-18, NOT yet tagged. One `capt-hook.toml`: `[pack]` manifest + `[packs.*]` enablement at `.claude/capt-hook.toml`; `pack attach` deleted for `claude plugin list --json` discovery (per-project snapshot, stat-tuple invalidation incl. managed-settings + `.d` drop-ins); bootstrap extras retargeted to the discover tail (no stderr notice — loguru only); scaffold/lint on the three-artifact contract. Zero migration code (user decision); legacy `packs.toml` silently ignored for rollout safety — do not "fix" to an error.

Review rounds: codex finder 12 findings (10 fixed, 2 rejected: [packs.x] comment preservation, roster retry-TTL); codex refuter broke 5/8 invariants, all fixed — warm hookd replay now carries **stdout** too (pre-existing stderr-only bug), whole-document rewrite guard, shared `[pack]`-aware manifest resolver (`resolve_manifest`, 4 candidates) used by discovery+lint+fetch+scaffold, OSError in the roster failure boundary.

Release: **tag only after fleet pre-staging** — sequence + checklist in cc-notes task d1cc6ac6 (backlog). Merge-not-rebase; version picked against PyPI at tag time.

Gotchas learned: bare `great-docs build` is dead since 0dc30013 — use `uv run --with "git+https://github.com/yasyf/cc-skills@main#subdirectory=tools/gd-build" gd-build build`; worktree sessions need `.claude/settings.local.json` `disableAllHooks` (committed hooks point at the worktree's own `.venv`) and `test_e2e_install` has a worktree-only cwd-shadowing artifact (anchor `run_cli` cwd); slop-cop flags on CHANGELOG/qmd bold-bullet + em-dash house style are expected — adjudicate, don't churn. Sequential implementers in a shared worktree beat parallel ones (jj/git index races). [[capt-hook-release-rollout-gotchas]] [[concurrent-release-race-protocol]]
